doability: upload camera-scale watch frames → asset_inline_preview → image_apply_adjustments normalise → image_select_by_prompt('the bright reflection on the watch crystal') + masked image_apply_adjustments → image_apply_monochromatic_tint uniform + image_add_grain matched → for PDP: reserve a true-colour frame, image_select_by_prompt(the dial)→invert→crop_to_bounds for isolation → image_crop_and_resize (downscale only) → export_html_to_express. No banned capability (tint not RGB halftone); no upscaling.
